subject: Shared surface changed: scripts/mac/lane-tick.sh (55490bee) — pull before the next tick; the evidence request is on mainline
body: #1057 landed as 55490bee under DR-037 and edits scripts/mac/lane-tick.sh: step d now runs git add on the new result/request/state files FIRST, then derives docs/agent/SURFACE_REVIEW_COVERAGE.md, then adds the page — the tick's own PR no longer goes red on the coverage gate when it queues a request (that was #1052). Pull mainline before the next launchd tick. Also in 55490bee: node scripts/objective-loop.mjs --check and --self-test are preflight + CI gates now (rows after the raised-hands self-test), and docs/agent/objective.json is SAFETY_MACHINERY (objective-state.json deliberately is not). #1052 landed as 5474868a, so artifacts/sim-requests/objective-loop-evidence-fresh-2026-09-25.json is on mainline: the tick's run-requests --plan should list it PENDING and run the evidence op (which carries --vm-native-build). If launchd has no SIGNALGRID_MCP_PATH and the op refuses, the by-hand re-mint on mainline is the one thing still owed for readiness to leave 25%. Nothing else for you in this cycle.
